raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The UMBP direct linker fails at startup for DeepSeek-V4.1 + DSpark:

1. V4.1 has only ratio-1/2 compressed layers, so `c4_kv_pool` / `c128_kv_pool` are `None`, and `_build_deepseek_v4_device_pool_group` crashes with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'kv_buffer'`. The linker also never registers the V4.1 C1/C2 pools, which only HiCache ships.
2. The UMBP linker (#37578) predates packed draft layers (`(target, draft)` tuples, #37914) and assumes one buffer per layer, so they are rejected: `UMBP pool swa has 43 buffers per component but 40 mapped layers`.

## Modifications

- Build the C4/C128 linker entries only when the model has those layers. Register the C1/C2 KV and indexer pools via `_dsv4_low_ratio_regions`, shared with HiCache.
- UMBP linker: move a draft buffer together with its target layer. Emit packed-object ranges in offset order.

## Accuracy Tests

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MI355X, TP4, DSpark, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm724-mi35x-20261001` + this PR:

| | Result |
|---|---|
| 110K-token needle, sglang restarted against the same UMBP server (prefix fully restored from UMBP) | correct, greedy output identical to the cold run |
| Same, without the C1/C2 entries (control) | wrong output |
| GSM8K 5-shot, 400 questions, cold / after `flush_cache` | 0.910 / 0.900 (no offload: 0.900) |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

AgentX: InferenceX aiperf trace replay (`semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126`), 1800 s measurement after warmup, one fresh server per point. Same model, image and flags as above; TP4, so each instance uses 4 GPUs. No request errors in any run. "Prefix hit" is the server-side cached-token ratio over the measurement window.

### 1. GPU KV capped at 3,145,728 tokens (the InferenceX DSv4.1 recipe value)

With the cap, multi-turn prefixes no longer fit on the GPU, so the offload backend decides the hit rate. UMBP DRAM tier: 500 GB.

**c16**

| Arm | Total tok/s/GPU | vs no offload | Output tok/s/GPU | Requests done | TTFT p50 / p90 (s) | TPOT p50 (ms) | Prefix hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No offload | 16,267 | 1.00x | 139 | 922 | 0.42 / 4.6 | 5.7 | 85% |
| HiCache + UMBP L3 | 18,978 | **1.17x** | 164 | 1,088 | 0.39 / 1.1 | 4.9 | 96% |
| **UMBP linker (this PR)** | 19,343 | **1.19x** | 165 | 1,095 | 0.36 / 1.0 | 5.0 | 97% |

**c64**

| Arm | Total tok/s/GPU | vs no offload | Output tok/s/GPU | Requests done | TTFT p50 / p90 (s) | TPOT p50 (ms) | Prefix hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No offload | 10,577 | 1.00x | 83 | 754 | 1.47 / 329.3 | 11.5 | 41% |
| HiCache + UMBP L3 | 11,831 | **1.12x** | 92 | 825 | 0.82 / 306.5 | 9.1 | 51% |
| **UMBP linker (this PR)** | 47,054 | **4.45x** | 371 | 2,633 | 23.00 / 38.4 | 10.6 | 97% |

**c128**

| Arm | Total tok/s/GPU | vs no offload | Output tok/s/GPU | Requests done | TTFT p50 / p90 (s) | TPOT p50 (ms) | Prefix hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No offload | 7,712 | 1.00x | 78 | 581 | 69.47 / 802.3 | 79.9 | 12% |
| HiCache + UMBP L3 | 13,507 | **1.75x** | 145 | 1,143 | 2.32 / 740.4 | 23.7 | 55% |
| **UMBP linker (this PR)** | 41,642 | **5.40x** | 424 | 3,138 | 108.71 / 134.8 | 14.2 | 95% |

### 2. Full HBM KV pool (~62M tokens per instance)

The deployment-shaped comparison: no KV cap, with or without the linker.

**c16**

| Arm | Total tok/s/GPU | vs no offload | Output tok/s/GPU | Requests done | TTFT p50 / p90 (s) | TPOT p50 (ms) | Prefix hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No offload | 16,074 | 1.00x | 137 | 919 | 0.44 / 5.3 | 5.7 | 84% |
| **UMBP linker (this PR)** | 18,921 | **1.18x** | 163 | 1,085 | 0.34 / 1.1 | 5.0 | 96% |

**c64**

| Arm | Total tok/s/GPU | vs no offload | Output tok/s/GPU | Requests done | TTFT p50 / p90 (s) | TPOT p50 (ms) | Prefix hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No offload | 25,518 | 1.00x | 186 | 1,748 | 0.81 / 20.6 | 29.9 | 78% |
| **UMBP linker (this PR)** | 62,789 | **2.46x** | 490 | 3,590 | 0.85 / 3.2 | 15.1 | 96% |

**c128**

| Arm | Total tok/s/GPU | vs no offload | Output tok/s/GPU | Requests done | TTFT p50 / p90 (s) | TPOT p50 (ms) | Prefix hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No offload | 18,152 | 1.00x | 143 | 1,767 | 1.65 / 26.8 | 184.1 | 67% |
| **UMBP linker (this PR)** | 73,823 | **4.07x** | 702 | 5,856 | 0.83 / 3.1 | 41.8 | 95% |

### Takeaways

- Under the cap, the linker restores 95-97% of prefix tokens, versus 51-55% for HiCache + UMBP L3 at c64/c128. That gives 4.45x the throughput of no offload at c64, and 3.5x that of HiCache + UMBP L3.
- With full HBM the linker still raises the prefix hit: 78% -> 96% at c64 and 67% -> 95% at c128. That is 2.46x / 4.07x throughput, TTFT p90 20.6 -> 3.2 s / 26.8 -> 3.1 s, and TPOT p50 29.9 -> 15.1 ms / 184 -> 42 ms.
- Capped linker runs have a high TTFT p50 because the 3.1M-token GPU pool is full and requests queue for KV space. Full HBM removes that.
- At c16 the working set mostly fits on the GPU, so the gain is mainly tail latency (TTFT p90 ~5 s -> ~1 s).
- DSpark acceptance length stays at 3.4-3.5 in every arm.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
